Name: Unicorn Rainbow Horse
Author: Roszpunka1990
Description:
I missed in the game unicron that I imanged in my head from some time. So here we go. I made 4 different colours.






It wroks with  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt'n Skin[/url]﻿.  This is my first mod so I hope it will work. I tested it my self and
the best result it has when it is working with adopt'n skin.

I used horse's form from this mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/759]Real Life Horses
[/url]

Instalation guide:
- Make sure you have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed as well
- Download my latest file and unzip it
- Navigate to your "Stardew Valley\Mods" folder and drop the extracted folder there
- Run the game to generate the config file (just leave it as-is or tweak the options to your liking)
